checks: measured history follows physics; current command matches authority; guide matches independent kinematic integration; accepted probabilities and draws retained exactly

protocol.retinal_positive_control: Temporary bright camera-facing annotation, then same marker outside excluded group; synchronous capture and unconditional cleanup.

claim: Viewer faithfully separates measured body history from a held-command kinematic projection and cannot supply retinal cues or change control state.
limits: One bounded UI run. Projection is not planned navigation or a physical trajectory prediction. This does not establish learned navigation or a new brain-level result.

authority.pilotWings: HandPilot supplies power, frequency and stabilizing wing commands
authority.navigationScript: none; settled descending and wing-plane motor outputs request local velocity and yaw
authority.behaviorFallback: zero translational/yaw request; HandPilot retains balance and velocity damping
authority.senses: engineered transduction; HS/VS and ocellar projection inputs bypass upstream visual processing
authority.neuralDecision: settled candidate MBON scores select odor attention, then checked approach/avoid modulates neural navigation
authority.neuralMotor: checked motor-neuron plane/shift trim; pilot retains amplitude/frequency
authority.bodyRoutines: passive contact; contact-only taste/reward; neural MN9 feeding extension; no supplied route or takeoff impulse
authority.retina: page-supplied rendered receptor observations; no visual target/bearing input to controller
